hunks.baseline: A hulking man reminiscent of a Minotaur glared at me with eyes as big as saucers.
hunks.sol: A hulking man reminiscent of a Minotaur glared at me with enormous, bulging eyes.

hunks.baseline: It was no different from the lines spoken by third-rate thugs in movies, but according to what I’d sensed with Qi Sense, that hulking man was neither a third-rate thug nor an inept wandering martial artist.
hunks.sol: It was no different from something a third-rate thug in a movie might say, but according to Qi Sense, this hulking man was neither a third-rate thug nor some inept wandering martial artist.

hunks.baseline: If a guy like that were a thug, the police—the people’s cane—wouldn’t stand a chance. Even the people’s sledgehammer wouldn’t be enough.
hunks.sol: If a guy like that were a thug, forget the police—the people’s cane. Even the people’s sledgehammer wouldn’t be enough.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, the epithets I’d heard just now—Huashan’s Lone Crane and the Three Plum Blossom Elites—flashed through my mind, but that was as far as it went.
hunks.sol: For a moment, the epithets I’d just heard—Huashan’s Lone Crane and the Three Plum Blossom Elites—flashed through my mind, but that was as far as it went.

hunks.baseline: No matter how I looked at him, he seemed more like a knife-wielder from Majang-dong or a twin-axe fighter from Seocho-dong than a crane or a plum blossom. Those sorts of nicknames seemed much more appropriate.
hunks.sol: No matter how I looked at him, he seemed more like the Majang-dong Knifeman or Seocho-dong Twin Axes than a crane or a plum blossom. Those sorts of nicknames suited him much better.

hunks.baseline: When I merely stared at him without answering, the hulking man, Chulwoo, frowned.
hunks.sol: When I merely stared without answering, the hulking man—Chulwoo—frowned.

hunks.baseline: “Have you ever seen such an outrageous bastard? How dare you speak so rudely to our Young Master?”
hunks.sol: “What an outrageous fellow. How dare you speak so rudely to our Young Master?”

hunks.baseline: “Is pretending not to hear someone a polite thing to do?”
hunks.sol: “And pretending not to hear someone is polite?”

hunks.baseline: “What are you ahem-ing about? How important do you think you are that you don’t answer when someone speaks to you?”
hunks.sol: “What are you ahem-ing about? How important do you think you are, refusing to answer when someone speaks to you?”

hunks.baseline: I stopped Hyuk Mujin as he reached for his sword scabbard.
hunks.sol: I stopped Hyuk Mujin as he reached for his sword.

hunks.baseline: “Please don’t stop me. Someone like this needs to be taught a harsh lesson!”
hunks.sol: “Please don’t stop me. Someone like him needs to be taught a harsh lesson!”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo opened his mouth with an incredulous expression.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo stared at him in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “Every day is a battle with my patience.”
hunks.sol: “Every day is a battle against my own patience.”

hunks.baseline: “You look like martial artists, so it would be best if you just went on your way. This man made a very serious mistake with me.”
hunks.sol: “You look like martial artists, so you’d be better off going on your way. This man wronged me badly.”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo grabbed the collar of *this man* and lifted him up. He was so strong that the heavyset middle-aged man shot straight into the air.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo grabbed *this man* by the collar and lifted him. He was so strong that the heavyset middle-aged man shot straight into the air.

hunks.baseline: While I was thinking, Chulwoo grabbed Woo Hwangtae by the collar and shook him violently.
hunks.sol: While I was thinking, Chulwoo shook Woo Hwangtae violently by the collar.

hunks.baseline: “Conversation sounds good. Then let’s have a private conversation somewhere without any people around.”
hunks.sol: “Conversation sounds good. Then let’s go somewhere without any people around and have a nice, intimate chat.”

hunks.baseline: Woo Hwangtae, who was being dragged along against his will, shouted like he was screaming for his life.
hunks.sol: Woo Hwangtae, who was being dragged away against his will, screamed,

hunks.baseline: “I was invited too. And I’m a simple, crude man by nature, so I don’t particularly care whether you’re meeting the Lesser Family Head or the Family Head.”
hunks.sol: “So was I. And I’m a simple, crude man by nature, so I don’t particularly care whether you’re meeting the Lesser Family Head or the Family Head.”

hunks.baseline: This wouldn’t do. Someone was going to die before I remembered his name.
hunks.sol: This wouldn’t do. Someone was going to die before I remembered where I’d heard his name.

hunks.baseline: I had no desire to get dragged into an unnecessary dispute, but there was something that bothered me about simply walking past.
hunks.sol: I had no desire to get dragged into an unnecessary dispute, but simply walking past didn’t sit right with me either.

hunks.baseline: *From what I’ve heard, he seems to be a fairly important guest.*
hunks.sol: *From the sound of it, he’s a fairly important guest.*

hunks.baseline: The fact that he was supposed to have a private audience with Jin Wikyung bothered me. So did Chulwoo’s casual disparagement of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
hunks.sol: The fact that he was supposed to meet privately with Jin Wikyung bothered me, as did Chulwoo’s casual disparagement of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.

hunks.baseline: “All that fat and you still have to make people’s lives difficult… Did you call me?”
hunks.sol: “Damn, you’re nothing but fat, making me work this hard… Did you call me?”

hunks.baseline: I continued, addressing Chulwoo, who had paused.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo paused, and I continued.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a good day. Wouldn’t it be better to work things out through conversation?”
hunks.sol: “It’s a good day. Wouldn’t it be better to talk things out?”

hunks.baseline: “Give it a rest?”
hunks.sol: “You want me to stop?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry for sticking my nose in where it doesn’t belong, but wouldn’t it look bad for the Jin Family of Taiyuan if guests started fighting on a day like this?”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry for sticking my nose where it doesn’t belong, but wouldn’t it look bad for the Jin Family of Taiyuan if its guests started fighting on a day like this?”

hunks.baseline: “Hey, Young Hero.”
hunks.sol: “Listen, Young Hero.”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo rubbed his neck with an annoyed expression. At the same time, his speech, which had previously been close to polite, was cut in half.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo rubbed his neck with an annoyed expression. At the same time, he dropped what little politeness remained in his speech.

hunks.baseline: “This is personal. If you stick your nose in, you’ll only make yourself tired.”
hunks.sol: “This is personal. If you get involved, you’ll only make trouble for yourself.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m already tired. What can you do?”
hunks.sol: “I’m already tired of this. What can you do?”

hunks.baseline: “Your speech is getting short?”
hunks.sol: “You’re getting awfully informal.”

hunks.baseline: “Yep. Same goes for you.”
hunks.sol: “Yep. Right back at you.”

hunks.baseline: “Twenty? Huh. Fresh as a daisy. Fresh as a daisy.”
hunks.sol: “Twenty? Ha. Still green. Nice and green.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m twenty-five, you young bastard.”
hunks.sol: “I’m twenty-five, you little brat.”

hunks.baseline: Even if he had been fed protein supplements instead of breast milk as a baby, he shouldn’t have ended up like this. I asked with considerable astonishment,
hunks.sol: Even if he had been fed protein supplements instead of breast milk as a baby, he shouldn’t have ended up like this. I asked in genuine astonishment,

hunks.baseline: “Twenty-five? Are you Benjamin? You’re living your life backward.”
hunks.sol: “Twenty-five? Is your name Benjamin or something? You’re living your life backward all by yourself.”

hunks.baseline: “What the fuck are you talking about?”
hunks.sol: “What kind of bullshit is that?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s not bullshit. It’s a fact. It must have been tough looking prematurely old.”
hunks.sol: “It’s not bullshit. It’s a fact. Looking that old must have made life tough.”

hunks.baseline: “Prematurely old? Shut up! Everyone around me thinks I look incredibly young!”
hunks.sol: “Old? Shut up! Everyone around me says I look young!”

hunks.baseline: “Everyone around you? Number one, your mother. Number two, your father. Number three, your grandmother. Pick one of the three. Oh, let’s make number four your youngest maternal aunt.”
hunks.sol: “Everyone around you? Number one, your mother. Number two, your father. Number three, your grandmother. Pick one of the three. Oh, let’s make number four your youngest aunt.”

hunks.baseline: “This beardless little brat…”
hunks.sol: “You beardless little brat…”

hunks.baseline: “Pull down your pants. I want to see whether you’ve got hair on your dick.”
hunks.sol: “Pull down your pants. Let’s see if you’ve got pubes yet.”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo released his grip on Woo Hwangtae’s collar. Trembling as he looked from the ground to the sky, he took several deep breaths.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo released Woo Hwangtae’s collar. Trembling as he looked back and forth between earth and sky, he drew a deep breath.

hunks.baseline: I had simply answered him one insult at a time, and somehow this was where we had ended up.
hunks.sol: I had merely returned each insult as it came, and somehow this was where we had ended up.

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo, snorting like a frenzied Minotaur, finally managed to open his mouth. It took him a great deal of effort. A very great deal.
hunks.sol: Snorting like a frenzied Minotaur, Chulwoo finally managed to force the words out. With great difficulty. Tremendous difficulty.

hunks.baseline: The sound of bones grinding came from the fist as large as a shovel handle.
hunks.sol: Bones shifted with an ugly crunch inside his fist, which was as thick as a shovel handle.

hunks.baseline: “Do you even know what it means to interfere in someone else’s personal gratitude and grudges in Murim?”
hunks.sol: “Do you even know what it means to interfere in someone else’s gratitude and grudges in Murim?”

hunks.baseline: “I already apologized for sticking my nose in where it didn’t belong. But if guests start throwing punches, what does that make the people who invited them? You ought to think about our family’s position too.”
hunks.sol: “I already apologized for sticking my nose where it doesn’t belong. But if guests start throwing punches, what does that make the people who invited them? You ought to consider our family’s position too.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you perhaps a member of the Jin Family of Taiyuan?”
hunks.sol: “Do you belong to the Jin Family’s household?”

preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “I don’t think I’m a freeloader.”
hunks.sol: “I’m no household parasite, if that’s what you mean.”

hunks.baseline: “Make one more wordplay joke and I’ll put you in bed for three years.”
hunks.sol: “Make one more wordplay joke, and I’ll put you in bed for three years.”

hunks.baseline: “Watch your mouth—unless you want your family mourning you for three years.”
hunks.sol: “Watch your mouth—unless you want your family observing three years of mourning.”

hunks.baseline: Chulwoo smiled thinly. It wasn’t a smile born of amusement. It was the kind of smile that appeared on its own when someone’s anger had reached the top of his head.
hunks.sol: Chulwoo smiled. It wasn’t a smile born of amusement, but the kind that appeared on its own when someone was furious beyond words.

hunks.baseline: The two-meter-tall giant launched himself like a cannonball. The time it took him to reach the tip of my nose was no more than an instant.
hunks.sol: The two-meter-tall giant launched himself like a cannonball. It took him only an instant to arrive directly in front of me.

hunks.baseline: With a chilling voice, the air scattered.
hunks.sol: The air scattered with his chilling words.

hunks.baseline: It was nothing more than a simple punch, with no form or martial principle added to it. The force contained in that fist exploded with enough momentum to shatter a thousand-jin boulder.
hunks.sol: It was nothing more than a simple punch, without any form or martial principle behind it. Yet the fist carried enough force to shatter a thousand-jin boulder.

hunks.baseline: *As long as it doesn’t hit me.*
hunks.sol: *It doesn’t matter if it doesn’t hit me.*

hunks.baseline: I bent backward as if lying down. The fist struck the air a handspan above me, and compressed air exploded from its tip. A tree more than ten feet away flew through the air as if caught in a typhoon.
hunks.sol: I bent backward as if lying down. The fist tore through the air a handspan above me, compressed air exploding from its tip. A tree more than ten feet away went flying as if caught in a typhoon.

hunks.baseline: I was left speechless by the overwhelming power.
hunks.sol: I had to marvel at the sheer power.

hunks.baseline: One punch, two punches, three. Each time I easily avoided another punch, my suspicion hardened into certainty.
hunks.sol: One punch, two punches, three. Each time I easily dodged another blow, my suspicion hardened into certainty.

hunks.baseline: No matter how powerful an attack was, it was useless if it failed to connect.
hunks.sol: No matter how powerful an attack was, it meant nothing if it failed to connect.

hunks.baseline: Moreover, Chulwoo was only at the early Peak realm and could not even project fist qi. If our martial insight was comparable, I had an overwhelming advantage.
hunks.sol: Moreover, Chulwoo had only just entered the Peak realm and couldn’t even project Fist Energy. If our martial insight was comparable, I had an overwhelming advantage.

hunks.baseline: “What the hell!”
hunks.sol: “You bastard!”

hunks.baseline: “You’re too excited. Take a deep breath and relax your body. That way, you might be able to touch even a single hair.”
hunks.sol: “You’re too worked up. Take a deep breath and relax. Then you might manage to touch a single hair on my head.”

hunks.baseline: Given the situation, Chulwoo also seemed considerably flustered.
hunks.sol: Given how things were going, Chulwoo also seemed considerably flustered.

hunks.baseline: “I am somewhat related to that man. As far as I know, we came from the same womb.”
hunks.sol: “I’m somewhat related to him. As far as I know, we came out of the same womb.”

hunks.baseline: He might not have known what *bingo* meant, but he understood its positive connotation and clenched his fist.
hunks.sol: He might not have known what *bingo* meant, but he understood that it meant yes and clenched his fist.

hunks.baseline: “Good grief, that’s a harsh assessment.”
hunks.sol: “Ma, that’s a stingy score.”

hunks.baseline: “Your mouth has reached the realm of transcendence.”
hunks.sol: “Your mouth has reached the realm of mastery.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s all psychological warfare. Take a look at yourself. You’re showing nothing but the whites of your eyes while throwing punches at thin air.”
hunks.sol: “It’s all psychological warfare. Take a look at yourself. Your eyes are rolled back, and you keep swinging at thin air.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t get confused. I simply had no desire to use my sect’s martial arts against an unknown nobody like you.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t get the wrong idea. I simply had no desire to use my sect’s martial arts against a nameless small fry like you.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. What a letdown.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. That takes the fun out of it.”

hunks.baseline: He was obviously a disciple of a fairly well-known sect, but if we fought until one of us fell, both of us would have to deal with the backlash.
hunks.sol: He was obviously a disciple of a fairly well-known sect, but if we fought until one of us fell, both of us would have to deal with the fallout.

hunks.baseline: If I added my age in the Murim to my age in the modern world, I was practically fifty. But there was no chance of getting that across to him.
hunks.sol: If I added my age in Murim to my age in the modern world, I was practically fifty. But there was no chance of getting that across to him.

hunks.baseline: “You son of a bitch! I could chew you up and still not feel satisfied!”
hunks.sol: “You bastard! I could chew you to pieces and still not be satisfied!”

hunks.baseline: It was at that moment, as Chulwoo raised his fist with a heavy snort, that someone’s voice abruptly cut in.
hunks.sol: Just as Chulwoo raised his fist with a heavy snort, someone’s voice abruptly cut in.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng alighted with an ethereal movement technique and swept over us with a chilly gaze.
hunks.sol: Wipeng descended with an elusive movement technique and swept us with a chilly gaze.

hunks.baseline: His eyes passed over Cheongpung, Hyuk Mujin, and Woo Hwangtae, whose appearance had become a complete mess from being dragged around, before finally pinning me and Chulwoo like arrows.
hunks.sol: His eyes passed over Cheongpung, Hyuk Mujin, and Woo Hwangtae, who was a complete mess after being dragged around, before finally shooting toward Chulwoo and me like arrows.

hunks.baseline: “Defeated Flower Fist, and Third Young Master.”
hunks.sol: “Defeated Flower Fist. Third Young Master.”

hunks.baseline: A voice colder than the northern wind and bitter snow froze the words in their throats.
hunks.sol: His voice, colder than the bitter winds and snow of the north, froze our next words solid.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe he got stuck.”
hunks.sol: “Maybe he’s blocked up.”

hunks.baseline: Just as the theory that Chulwoo was constipated was all but confirmed, the people who spotted a group of people and horses coming down the hill burst into cheers.
hunks.sol: Just as the theory that Chulwoo was constipated was all but confirmed, the people who spotted a party of riders coming down the hill burst into cheers.

hunks.baseline: There was a face among them that no martial artist in Shanxi Province could possibly fail to recognize.
hunks.sol: Among them was a face no martial artist in Shanxi Province could possibly fail to recognize.

hunks.baseline: Every time they did, cheers erupted from all directions, along with hands reaching out to touch even their clothing.
hunks.sol: Each time they did, cheers erupted from all directions, and countless hands reached out for even the hems of their clothes.

hunks.baseline: While everyone looked on with warm smiles, the broadly grinning Jin Taekyung and Chulwoo exchanged words in very low voices.
hunks.sol: While everyone watched them with warm smiles, the beaming Jin Taekyung and Chulwoo exchanged words in voices so low they were barely audible.

hunks.baseline: “Now that I think about it, same here.”
hunks.sol: “Now that I think about it, neither did I.”

hunks.baseline: “Is this guy completely insane?”
hunks.sol: “Are you completely insane?”

hunks.baseline: Amid the tremendous cheers, a fierce exchange took place—one that only Peak masters could hear.
hunks.sol: Amid the thunderous cheers, a fierce exchange unfolded—one only Peak masters could hear.
